The design text is a DRAFT, so the seal records its sha256 and a spec_sha computed from the SPEC constants (spec_sha_kind draft_constants_canonical_json). Runs under the heavy-job lock convention, never beside a multi-GB job. Fix MUST 2 (10.1): a full day is a UTC day with 12 classified captures; with fewer than 3 full days rule (a) is not evaluable and the window is extended to 42 days (decided before any output; no re-run); the output and the last stdout line print full_days and rule_a_result. Exit codes: 1 output exists, 2 declared refusal, 3 pin mismatch, 4 uncaught exception, 75 guard. --last-days 8 is kept because the design text (10.1) says 8; risk: the host keeps captures about 8 days, so the oldest capture can be removed by retention during the run (the run reads the newest 8 days; a mid-run removal would surface as exit 4 or a counted missing slot, not a silent change); lower to 7 only by a design-text change.
